regressions.what: The formerly overbuilt cobble ridge has nearly disappeared, leaving a flatter sand strip with fewer stones and visible roots than the target.
The brighter cascade now produces a more conspicuous inverted white silhouette beneath the inlet.
The far shoreline has darkened and lost some of the sunlit olive vegetation visible along the target waterline.

blockers.target: Short blue-grey reflections run around the boulders and across the visible gravel to the bottom edge.
blockers.current: The foreground reads as brown gravel beneath an almost reflectionless sheet.
blockers.change: Carry broken cool sky reflections into both foreground corners and turn the streaks around each boulder while retaining visible gravel between them.

blockers.where: A3–B4 left bank and C3–D3 outlet boulders
blockers.target: The grass lip shades a dark earth face while the downstream rock faces retain grey fracture detail.
blockers.current: Direct light floods the sandy bank strip while the boulder faces fall almost to black.
blockers.change: Place the left earth face in the turf lip’s shadow and lift indirect light on the downstream rock faces until their cracks remain legible.

blockers.target: Soft vertical olive reflections join the far shore to the lake and break into small ripples toward the outlet.
blockers.current: A blue stippled patch and broad tan patch dominate the pool while the shoreline reads as a thin dark strip.
blockers.change: Extend soft olive shoreline reflections toward the lake center and break up the broad tan highlight with low-contrast ripples.

blockers.target: White spilling water surrounds narrow teal gaps and leaves a vertically blurred pale reflection.
blockers.current: Hard-edged white and dark teal wedges repeat almost intact below the waterline.
blockers.change: Join the white centers across each falling lip and blur the reflected silhouette into horizontal bands below the inlet.

next.target: An irregular overhang exposes hanging roots above separated grey cobbles embedded at its foot.
next.current: A smooth sandy ramp meets dense grass along a mostly flush edge.
next.change: Cut a recessed face below the turf, bend exposed roots downward at varied lengths and embed separated cobbles along the slope foot.

next.target: Uneven stands of tall upright reeds project into a broad ridge of individual grey pebbles.
next.current: Low rounded grass clumps cover most of the bank and end against a narrow sandy strip.
next.change: Pull the grass back in irregular pockets, fill them with overlapping grey pebbles and place taller reed groups at the waterside points.

next.target: Sloping fractured shoulders split the current and carry broken white foam around their flanks.
next.current: Steep angular shoulders rise above dark water with little visible upstream foam contact.
next.change: Bevel the tallest shoulders and wrap broken foam from each upstream contact around both flanks into narrow downstream trails.

excluded: Distant mountains and sky are outside this pass.
unverifiable: The still captures cannot establish water, foam or vegetation motion.
